name: Category tile grid
looks: Dozens of small, differently coloured tiles fill in behind a bold headline, each carrying a short label, arriving on a loose stagger until the grid is dense, deliberately too many to read individually, so the shot sells breadth before the product narrows it down.
build: A CSS/DOM grid of fixed-size cards, each with a random accent fill from a small palette and a short label; cards scale and fade in (0 -> 1, power2.out) on a per-card seeded delay so the build feels organic. The headline stays layered above at full contrast.
sound: A fast, granular patter of soft ticks as the tiles land, overlapping into a wash by the time the grid is full.
prompt: Behind a short, confident headline, fill the frame with a dense, loosely staggered grid of small coloured tiles, each labelled with a different option or category, deliberately too many to read one by one, so the shot says there is a lot to sort through before the product does the sorting.
